title: Add Jest unit coverage for ContentModerator.checkMessage's routing/fail-open branches
description: server/services/moderationService.js (ContentModerator, the AI content-moderation gate — decides whether a chat message is blocked/flagged before it reaches FlaggedMessage) has zero test coverage per TESTING_GAPS.md Priority 1. Not covered by any server/docs/agents/*.md routing entry (checked server/CLAUDE.md's table — no match), so no cross-check needed there. This is a plain class, not an Express route: instantiate `new ContentModerator()` directly and call `checkMessage(...)`, no supertest/{app} needed (mirrors the existing DB-free unit pattern in server/tests/rateLimit.test.js, which builds its own minimal app rather than requiring server/index). No DB connection needed either — do not call prisma.$connect(). Mock 'openai' (module default export used as `new OpenAI(...)`; mock `.moderations.create`) and '@google/generative-ai' (destructured `{ GoogleGenerativeAI }`; mock `.getGenerativeModel().generateContent`) with jest.mock. Do NOT set REDIS_URL in the test env — SecurityManager only connects to Redis `if (process.env.REDIS_URL)`, so leaving it unset makes it fall back to the local in-memory LRUCache path with zero Redis mocking required. Set OPENAI_API_KEY and GOOGLE_API_KEY to dummy non-empty strings before constructing ContentModerator (constructor gates client creation on `!!process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY` / `GOOGLE_API_KEY`). Cover: (1) an empty message returns `{ isSafe: true }` immediately, with the mocked OpenAI/Gemini clients never called; (2) with OPENAI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY unset, checkMessage returns `{ isSafe: true, reviewNeeded: true, source: 'system_down' }`; (3) OpenAI moderations.create returning no flagged categories above threshold returns `{ isSafe: true, source: 'openai_clean' }` without calling the mocked Gemini generateContent; (4) OpenAI flags a category above its `block`/`flag` threshold (e.g. mock category_scores.harassment above the TEEN block threshold of 0.80) — verify it escalates to the mocked Gemini call and returns Gemini's parsed verdict (mock generateContent to resolve a JSON string `{"isSafe":false,"reason":"test"}`, expect `{ isSafe: false, reason: 'test', source: 'gemini_decision' }`); (5) OpenAI's moderations.create rejecting (mock a thrown error) is caught and fails open: `{ isSafe: true, reviewNeeded: true, source: 'fail_open_error', auditData: { error: <message> } }` — this fail-open safety net must never throw or block a message on an internal error.
